title: UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED Improper Authentication in Apache SeaTunnel Web 1.0.2 allows a user whose account has been…
description: Apache SeaTunnel Web 1.0.2 contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows users with disabled accounts to authenticate successfully and obtain new login tokens. The login process does not verify account status, enabling continued access despite account disabling. This issue requires valid credentials and does not allow credential-free bypass. The product is no longer maintained, and no fixed release exists. Users are advised to discontinue use of this unsupported component.
